source.split_policy: Reserve deterministic initial-state-grouped complete episodes for validation (T6=10, T8=8, seed42); train on remaining episodes only. Official Raw last20 remains final closed-loop test, not checkpoint selection.

execution.previous_memory_alignment: target[t-20] for t>=20, otherwise generic initial memory; never target[t-1]
execution.history_observations: Every recorded observation from max(0,t-20) through t, inclusive; no future observations or predicted actions.
execution.time_alignment: Stored obs[t] and metadata[t] precede actions[t]. Actions supervised at t are actions[t:min(t+20,N)].
execution.tail_policy: Pad action targets only for tensor shape and mask absent timesteps in the loss; do not duplicate terminal actions or cross episode boundaries.
execution.boundary_provenance: Every recorded frame is a training candidate. Overlapping future20 targets are intentional; deployment executes20 and updates memory every20.

visual.image_augmentation: none; do not color-jitter, rotate, crop, or flip semantically annotated images
visual.stored_image_orientation: Use refined HDF5 images as stored. For live simulation reproduce the official recorder's net vertical flip, not ordinary LIBERO's 180-degree conversion.
visual.entity_selection: Show the task's bowls with stable colors, including current/reference points when stationary; initial points are not evidence of executed motion.
visual.identity: Build and validate the complete episode name/segmentation-ID registry. Use the canonical renderer's numeric-ID ordering and palette; never reassign colors from current positions.
visual.trajectory: Measured visible-mask centres in source-image coordinates. Split at missing/unreliable observations; no interpolation through gaps, future fitting, independent zoom or path displacement.
visual.dense_rendering_selection: Every dense observation participates in joint time-linear simplification with maximum 1.5 source-pixel error. Draw only actual measured vertices; retain all visibility transitions and explicit gaps. Render indices refer to the selected-frame list, while source frame indices remain unchanged.
visual.robot_image_slot: Replace base_0_rgb with the enhanced image; retain the genuine wrist observation; keep absent right_wrist_0_rgb masked.

memory.action_scope: Observed image-centre motion, not physical-height motion or independently verified grasp/release success.
memory.direction_method: Within contiguous reliable observations, simplify using spatial error against time-linear interpolation, preserving reversals. Merge only consecutive identical directions; preserve unknown gaps.
memory.goal_evidence: Causal official completion annotations in exo_boxes/ego_boxes entity entries; robot annotations preferred. Reuse the established strict trace parsing pattern; exclude meta.success, dones, rewards and future records.
memory.task6_goal: Seven ordered returns of akita_black_bowl_1 to plate_1, as certified by the official sequence state machine; initial On is not counted as a completed cycle.
memory.completion_scope: Task completion means the ordered sequence has been certified as completed by the current observation. It does not independently prove current contact persistence or absence of overshoot.
memory.previous_memory: Use target[t-20] for t>=20; otherwise the generic English initial memory without a known goal count. Never feed the current target or target[t-1].
memory.inference_memory: Use model-generated previous memory. No current movement summary, oracle goal count or ground-truth memory may be fed back during evaluation.

dataset.path_policy: Paths in train.jsonl are relative to dataset root.

episode_arrays.states: float32[N,8]: ee_pos3 + existing axis-angle ee_ori3 + gripper_states2
episode_arrays.actions: float32[N,7], existing delta controls; no second delta conversion
episode_arrays.centres: float32[N,K,2] source-image centres with explicit validity

dataset.normalization: Compute state/action mean, std, q01, q99, min and max from all valid dense training rows only. Use q01/q99 bounds unless equal, then use that dimension's training min/max; retain epsilon=1e-6 and never clip. Save one norm_stats.json for identical training/inference transforms.
dataset.coverage: Retain every released episode and every source action via the 20-step targets, including final partial chunks. No silent episode filtering, no-op removal or drop_last.

model.trainable_parameters: Every nnx.Param leaf: vision, language model, action expert, embedding, projections and time MLPs. No LoRA factors or frozen parameter leaves; float32 master weights.
model.initialization: Strictly restore every original base parameter into float32 master weights; no added adapters or random replacement base parameters.
model.language_head: Existing tied embedding decoder with newly implemented supervised CE; do not claim an existing official pi05 language-training API.
model.token_capacity: Measure full-corpus condition and target lengths independently, round each capacity up to a multiple of 32, never truncate, and reuse the saved capacities at inference.
model.conditioning: Original instruction, actual normalized state, augmented current main image, genuine wrist image, and previous three-level memory.
model.teacher_isolation: Neither observation-prefix queries nor action queries may attend to current teacher-forcing text. Action RoPE positions depend only on valid condition tokens and action positions, never target length.

training.flow_loss: Optimize mean squared flow error over physical action dimensions 0:7 and valid future timesteps only. Retain native32 output; flow32 is detached diagnostic only. Total loss = flow7 + text_loss_weight * text_ce.
training.coverage: Shuffle training episodes' decision samples deterministically; visit every row before starting next epoch, mask final global-batch padding without dropping or duplicating real samples. Run exactly10000 optimizer updates.
training.checkpoints: Retain all five milestone checkpoints at updates2000,4000,6000,8000,10000 with full parameters, optimizer, RNG, sampler and train-only normalization. Do not prune milestones.
training.validation: At each milestone evaluate all held-out expert-observation samples on two distinct selected GPUs, one per teacher_history and generated_history mode, concurrently; complete and merge both reports before accepting the checkpoint. Use fixed action sampling seeds; report physical7 action errors and free-generated text metrics with explicit invalid/missing denominators.
training.validation_text_decoder: Keep original full-forward Gemma logits and greedy/EOS/memory-capacity rules, but run the token loop on-device and transfer only chosen IDs/finite flags once. On the real English checkpoint, all output fields matched the original for 42 T6/T8 rows per history mode; the numerically divergent KV-cache candidate is not used.

interfaces.renderer: render_adapter.CanonicalRenderer(renderer_js): render(rgb, frame, history_start, registry, tracks) returns (png_bytes, diagnostics); close() releases its browser. Inputs are already-stored-orientation RGB and causal dense track points.
interfaces.policy: policy.JointMemoryPolicy(checkpoint_dir): infer(main_rgb, wrist_rgb, state, instruction, previous_memory_text) returns actions[20,7], memory_text and parsed memory validity/completion. No simulator oracle fields.
interfaces.policy_process: policy.py --serve-json CHECKPOINT supports JSON-lines requests/responses with base64 PNGs, state8, instruction and previous_memory_text, so simulation can use a separate Python environment.
interfaces.integration_owner: Parent session owns shared contract, canonical renderer adapter, deployment and execution; implementation tasks own explicitly assigned files and skip build/lint/tests/formatters until integration.

required: Full HDF5/metadata episode and frame reconciliation
All sample images rendered from causal dense histories
Strict goal-label identity and ordinal parsing
No teacher text or target-length leakage into action outputs
Finite real-weight forward/backward with every parameter in the optimizer
Nonzero updates in vision, VLM, action and other projection parameters
Real action and three-level text inference
Available LIBERO-Mem closed-loop smoke using generated memory, not oracle feedback
verification.evaluation_scope: Separate training loss, offline probes and closed-loop outcomes. Use official Raw held-out initial states when available; otherwise label training-initial-state diagnostics explicitly. Never call refined last-20 episodes an unseen split.
